newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to hold investment conference in London.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to hold investment conference in London.

text.p: Senior Moroccan finance officials, headed by Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj, will hold a conference in London on investment in Morocco on Thursday and Friday, a finance ministry official said on Tuesday.
The two-day conference, aimed to lure foreign investment to the North African country's emerging market, will be attended by senior executives from around the world, the official said.
Kabbaj will adress the conference, organised by Japanese Nomura International Plc, on the investments and capital market in Morocco.
Other Moroccan senior officials will also speak at the London conference about sweeping economic liberalisation.
